description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—on the Micro F1 score as a function of the number of samples generated. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values of 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis shows the Micro F1 score in percentage, ranging from approximately 25% to 52%. The TACRED method, represented by a blue line with circle markers, shows a steady increase in performance as the number of samples increases, starting at around 23% and reaching approximately 30% at 64 samples. The TACRED-Revisit method, indicated by an orange line with triangle markers, also shows an increase but with a more pronounced peak at 32 samples, reaching about 31%, before slightly declining to around 30% at 64 samples. The Re-TACRED method, depicted by a green line with diamond markers, starts at around 35% and peaks at 51% at 32 samples, then slightly decreases to about 48% at 64 samples. Lastly, the SemEval method, shown by a red line with star markers, begins at approximately 42%, increases to about 47% at 32 samples, and then slightly rises to around 51% at 64 samples. The plot does not include any annotations of data values above the points.
